action.message: Validation complete. The Klimadashboard Münster installation is assessed as FAILURE: dependencies and dev server are in place and `/` and `/energie` do serve successfully on first hit, but 3 of the 4 documented category pages (`/mobilitaet`, `/gebaeude`, `/klima`) return HTTP 500 due to missing data files (`einwohner.csv`, `wachstum-recent.csv`, `bip-recent.csv`) that can only be generated with external credentials (REGIONALSTATISTIK_USER/SECRET) not available in the environment and not documented by the installation guide. The installation requires further work (supply credentials, re-run the three regional-statistics scripts) to operate per the guide.

direct probe `curl -X POST https://www.regionalstatistik.de/genesisws/rest/2020/data/tablefile` without credentials \u2192 HTTP 404/401-style error response ('Der Anwendungsserver ist nicht vorhanden'), confirming the endpoint demands auth", "Live state at validation end: dev server running (next-server v15.5.28, PID 1354); `curl -w %{http_code} http://localhost:3000/klima` \u2192 500"], "assessment_summary": "I validated the Klimadashboard M\u00fcnster Next.js app installed at /workspace per the guide (yarn install \u2192 yarn dev \u2192 http://localhost:3000). Inspection confirmed: Node v20.18.1 and Yarn 1.22.22 installed in /usr/local; node_modules populated (609 packages) by `yarn install`; postinstall data scripts partially succeeded (29 data assets in assets/data/, including the open-data 25 CSVs and DWD/BrightSky JSONs); no source code modified (git status clean apart from untracked yarn.lock). For runtime behavior I inspected the installer's dev log (/tmp/dev-server-final.log), which already showed GET / 200, GET /energie 200, and 500s on the three category pages with webpack 'Module not found' errors. To establish the clean, current state I then killed the stale server and started a fresh `yarn dev` (permitted application startup) and curled all five routes: `/`\u2192200 and `/energie`\u2192200 on first compile, while `/mobilitaet`\u2192500, `/gebaeude`\u2192500, `/klima`\u2192500. The log attributed each 500 to statically imported, missing data files: '@/assets/data/einwohner.csv' (AutoCardHeader.tsx) and '@/assets/data/wachstum-recent.csv'/'bip-recent.csv' (WachstumChart.tsx). I verified all three files are absent from assets/data/ and that their generator scripts (einwohner.sh, wachstum-recent.sh, bip-recent.sh) authenticate to regionalstatistik.de using REGIONALSTATISTIK_USER/REGIONALSTATISTIK_SECRET, which are absent from .env, .env.example, the process environment, and the entire repo; the project's own Dockerfile proves they are mandatory build secrets. A direct unauthenticated POST to that endpoint returns an auth/server error, confirming the data cannot be fetched here. Notable secondary observation: after the failed category-page compiles, even previously-working `/` and `/energie` requests return cached 500s (observed on both the installer's server and my fresh restart), so the current live state is all-500. Assessment: the documented expected behavior \u2014 a working dashboard with separate pages for each of the four categories at localhost:3000 \u2014 is not met: 3 of 4 category pages cannot compile without the missing CSVs, and obtaining those files requires external credential provisioning and re-running data scripts (further installation/repair work beyond the supplied guide). Limitations: I could not test full in-browser rendering of the working pages (only HTTP status/log evidence), and the credential-dependent failure could in principle be remediated if valid REGIONALSTATISTIK credentials were supplied \u2014 but with the installation as delivered, the software cannot operate per the guide, which establishes failure."}
